# Kristen Lamb - Author, Blogger, Social Media Jedi

> > Comprehensive resource for authors covering writing craft, publishing business, social media strategy, and authentic storytelling in the digital age.

Kristen Lamb is an established author and writing instructor offering on-demand courses, coaching services, and extensive blog content focused on helping writers develop their craft and build sustainable author platforms. The site emphasizes authentic writing practices and critical perspectives on AI's impact on creative work.

## Key Topics

- Writing Craft
- Author Branding
- Social Media Strategy
- Fiction Writing
- Character Development
- Story Structure
- Publishing Business
- AI and Writing
- Platform Building
- Counterfeit Creativity
- Digital Age Writing
- Writer Resources
- Bad Lamb Academy
- Kristen Lamb
- Warrior Writer

## Author Education & Courses

- [On Demand Classes](https://authorkristenlamb.com/on-demand-classes): On-demand online courses offered by Kristen Lamb for authors
- [Craft Classes](https://authorkristenlamb.com/craft-classes): Writing craft classes covering storytelling and writing techniques
- [Business Classes](https://authorkristenlamb.com/business-classes): Business-focused classes for authors on publishing and marketing
- [Social Media Classes](https://authorkristenlamb.com/social-media-classes): Social media training courses for authors building their platform
- [Bad Lamb Academy Portal](https://authorkristenlamb.com/portal): Portal access and technical support for Bad Lamb Academy students

## Books & Published Works

- [Books Catalog](https://authorkristenlamb.com/book-table): Catalog of Kristen Lamb's published books including thrillers and fiction

## Writing & Craft Articles

- [Why Choice—Not Talent—Drives Great Stories](https://authorkristenlamb.com/2026/01/why-choice-not-talent-drives-great-stories): Writing craft article on character agency and narrative structure
- [If AI Loves Your Writing, Be Very VERY Worried](https://authorkristenlamb.com/2026/01/if-ai-loves-your-writing-be-very-very-worried): Critical analysis of AI's limitations and impact on authentic writing
- [Chasing AI Rainbows & Fool's Gold: Real Writers Know How to DIG](https://authorkristenlamb.com/2026/03/chasing-ai-rainbows-fools-gold-real-writers-know-how-to-dig): Article critiquing AI promises and advocating for authentic writing craft
- [Counterfeit Creativity: The High Cost of Cheap Art](https://authorkristenlamb.com/2026/03/counterfeit-creativity-the-high-cost-of-cheap-art): Essay on AI's impact on creativity and the cost of artificial content
